_about: The film's scene list. For each scene: id (its builder in src/film.js), dur (seconds), colour and deep (its two colours), kicker, title and line (the words on screen), say (the spoken line). A scene spoken phrase by phrase also has beats ([story progress 0..1, phrase]) and story (the seconds its animation was written for); tighten.py derives cues and warp from those. author is shown in the closing credits; language (a key of score.LANG_CODE) is the language the words are written in: the page declares it and the voice speaks it. Read by build.py, make_audio.py and tighten.py. Author: Muhammad Akhtar Shamim. Licence: MIT (see LICENSE).

scenes.title: Weeks of late nights.
scenes.line: One project. Coffee, code, and everything you had.
scenes.say: You know this story. Weeks of late nights, poured into one project!

scenes.title: Everyone ships their work.
scenes.line: An app. A report. A pitch deck. And then… silence.
scenes.say: An app! A report! A pitch deck! And then? Nothing.

scenes.title: Nobody is listening.
scenes.line: Long pages. Endless slides. Flow diagrams. Sequence diagrams.
scenes.say: They take it to meetings. Long pages! Endless slides! Diagrams! And everyone tunes out.

scenes.title: Great films take great crews.
scenes.line: A whole crew of specialists. Many small projects never get one.
scenes.say: Great films take great crews! Every job, a specialist. Real craft. But small projects rarely get one.
beats: Real craft. But small projects rarely get one.
cues: Real craft. But small projects rarely get one.

scenes.title: One prompt starts it. Your project makes its own trailer.
scenes.line: An AI assistant, a 3D engine, an AI voice and music, working as one.
scenes.say: What if your project made its own trailer? One prompt starts it! The script! The scenes! The voice! The music! And out comes your film!
beats: What if your project made its own trailer?
cues: What if your project made its own trailer?

scenes.title: It starts with your project files.
scenes.line: Code, documents, slides, spreadsheets, PDFs. An AI assistant reads them and drafts the script; you approve it.

scenes.title: Your story comes alive in 3D.
scenes.line: Every building, car and person is drawn by code. No camera.
scenes.say: Step two. Your story, alive in three D! Streets! People! Motion! Any angle! All of it, just code!

scenes.title: An AI voice tells your story.
scenes.line: Many voices, several languages. No microphone needed.
scenes.say: Step three. An AI voice tells it. Choose a voice! Choose a language! Timed to every scene. Change a word? It is spoken again.

scenes.title: An original backing track, made in code.
scenes.line: Instrumental only. No song, singer or recording is copied. Real songs still need real musicians.
scenes.say: Step four. A backing track, made in code. Chords! Drums! Bass! Melody! No song copied. No artist imitated. Real songs need real musicians!

scenes.title: One page. Or one video.
scenes.line: It plays in a modern browser, and exports as an MP4 to share. This film, counted:

scenes.line: Same project. Same people. This time it is a film.
